title: Rigidity Theorems for the Weyl Problem of Convex Surfaces in Hyperbolic 3-Space
summary: In this paper, we study the rigidity of noncompact convex sets in hyperbolic 3-space. We prove that any intrinsic isometry between the boundaries of two closed, noncompact convex subsets of hyperbolic 3-space of dimension at least two extends to a global isometry of the ambient space, provided that their ideal boundaries are circle-type closed sets with countably many connected components. Moreover, the same conclusion holds if the ideal boundaries consist of finitely many mutually disjoint disks together with a set of one-dimensional Hausdorff measure zero.
